Hi Marissa,

Quick note as we start the renewal conversation for Acme Health (license account ACM-42). Our fiscal team would like to align Redwood’s anniversary to our fiscal year start (2027-01-01) rather than the current 2026-10-15. That would simplify our procurement and budget planning.

We’re open to a structured approach: move the anniversary to 2027-01-01 (rollover), and spread the incremental uplift over a 12–18 month ramp so we don’t take a cliff increase in Q4. On the commercial side we’d prefer an auto-renew with a 60-day opt-out window, and a small annual price step rather than a large front-loaded uplift.

Attached: Acme_Renewal_Draft_Q3.docx (draft terms)

- A rollover pro-rate / credit for the 2.5 month shift
- A staged ramp schedule (year 1 50%, year 2 100% of target commit)
- Any volume discount thresholds tied to expanded capacity (we expect a 30% uplift in token consumption this year)

Would love to sync with procurement (cc’d) and have a redline by end of next week if possible.

Thanks,
Tom

Hi Tom — thanks for the clear ask and the helpful draft. I’ve gone through the proposal with Commercial and Ops and we can outline a pragmatic path that preserves your budget cadence and gives you a predictable ramp. High level:

1) Horizon rollover: we can move the anniversary to 2027-01-01. For the 2.5 month gap we propose a one-time credit equal to the unused portion of the current period rather than a straight pro-rate; this keeps billing simple and preserves your consumed token bucket.

2) Staged uplift schedule:
- Period A (2027-01-01 -> 2027-06-30): 50% of target incremental commit (soft top-up with overage protection)
- Period B (2027-07-01 -> 2028-01-01): 100% of target commit (full reserved capacity)

We’ll include a measured ramp trigger so if actual consumption lags we can convert residual to usage credits rather than auto-bill.

3) Auto-renew / opt-out: we can do auto-renew with a 60-day opt-out window and a one-time option for you to lock in pricing for an extra 12 months if you prepay a portion of Year 2.

4) Capacity & discounts: we can tier a volume threshold at 25% uplift (credit kick-in) and a higher discount band at 50% uplift. I’ve asked Legal to scope a narrow SLA exception for the rollover window; attached is an initial exceptions workbook for your procurement team to complete.

Next steps:
- I’ll share a mutual action plan (MAP) with dates and deliverables by EOD.
- Can we schedule a 30-minute procurement call on Wed 21 July 10:00–11:00 PT?

Attached: SLA_Exceptions.xlsx

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
